projects.description: Interim-Mandat · B2C Internet & Telekommunikation - Abogeschäft · Projektsprachen Deutsch & Englisch Über die Rolle Für einen B2C-Internetanbieter suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die den Kundenservice als Interim Head of Customer Service kurzfristig stabilisiert und nachhaltig neu aufstellt. Das interne Customer-Service-Team mit fünf Mitarbeitenden bearbeitet die eingehenden Tickets, kommt dem aktuellen Volumen aber nicht mehr hinterher. Ergänzend übernimmt ein externer Call-Center-Dienstleister den telefonischen Kundenkontakt. Inhaltlich dominieren Abrechnungsthemen und technische Probleme der Privatkunden mit ihrem Internetanschluss. Sie übernehmen die operative Verantwortung, schaffen Transparenz über Rückstände und deren Ursachen und bringen Team, Dienstleister, Prozesse und Tools auf Kurs. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit einem Prozessmanager zusammen und stimmen sich mit den Business Units der Muttergesellschaft ab, die bereits erfolgreich mit ServiceNow arbeiten. Ihre Aufgaben Leitung des Kundenservice mit Verantwortung für Servicequalität, Erreichbarkeit, Bearbeitungszeiten und Kundenzufriedenheit. People Management intern: Führung, Coaching und Motivation des fünfköpfigen Customer-Service-Teams; klare Prioritäten, Rollen und Arbeitsorganisation schaffen. Backlog-Abbau: Ticketvolumen, Ursachen und Engpässe analysieren, Sofortmaßnahmen umsetzen und eine belastbare Kapazitätsplanung aufbauen. Steuerung des Call-Center-Dienstleisters: SLAs und KPIs festlegen und nachhalten, Forecasting, regelmäßige Performance-Reviews, Eskalationsmanagement sowie eine saubere Schnittstelle zwischen Call Center und internem Team. Problemlösung bei Abrechnungsthemen: wiederkehrende Fehler, Reklamationen und Gutschriften analysieren und gemeinsam mit Billing und Finance die Ursache beheben (Zusammen mit Head of Finance) Problemlösung bei technischen Störungen: Internetprobleme der B2C-Kunden strukturiert bearbeiten und mit Technik und Netzbetrieb wirksame Lösungs- und Eskalationswege etablieren. Ticketing-Tool challengen: das bestehende System hinsichtlich Workflows, Kategorisierung, Routing, Automatisierung und Reporting kritisch prüfen. Tool-Entscheidung und Implementierung: eine Entscheidungsvorlage zur künftigen Tool-Landschaft erarbeiten und bei Bedarf Auswahl und Einführung eines neuen Tools verantworten. Best Practices der Muttergesellschaft nutzen: Erfahrungen und Standards aus dem ServiceNow-Einsatz der Gruppe erschließen, auf die lokalen Anforderungen übertragen und im Team verankern. Prozessoptimierung gemeinsam mit dem Prozessmanager: Service-Prozesse end-to-end analysieren, verschlanken und dokumentieren, etwa Ticket-Lifecycle, Eskalationswege und Wissensdatenbank. KPI-Reporting aufbauen, z. B. zu Backlog, First Contact Resolution, Bearbeitungszeit, SLA-Erfüllung und Kundenzufriedenheit, für Geschäftsführung und Gruppe. Stakeholder-Management mit den Business Units der Muttergesellschaft auf Deutsch und Englisch. Übergabe vorbereiten: Strukturen, Prozesse und Dokumentation so aufsetzen, dass eine dauerhafte Leitung nahtlos übernehmen kann. Ihr Profil Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung im Customer Service, idealerweise im B2C-Umfeld eines Telekommunikations-, Internet- oder Energieanbieters bzw. eines anderen Vertrags- und Abo-Geschäfts. Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Call-Center- und Outsourcing-Partner, inklusive SLA-, KPI- und Performance-Management. Erfolgsbilanz im Abbau von Rückständen und in der Stabilisierung von Service-Organisationen unter Druck. Fundierte Kenntnisse von Ticketing- und Service-Management-Systemen; Erfahrung mit ServiceNow sowie mit Tool-Auswahl und -Implementierung von Vorteil. Verständnis für Abrechnungsprozesse sowie für die technischen Grundlagen von Internetanschlüssen (z. B. DSL, Kabel, Glasfaser) ist von Vorteil Klare, empathische Führung und souveräne, durchsetzungsstarke Steuerung nach außen. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

projects.description: Location: Remote (100%) We are seeking a Senior IT Architect / Analyst to research, design, and evaluate methods for building high-quality knowledge graphs (KGs) and using them in AI applications — especially LLM and agent-based systems. You will work at the intersection of semantic modeling, information extraction, graph analytics, and AI evaluation: defining what "good" graph quality means, benchmarking the methods that produce graphs, and designing reasoning workflows that stay grounded in graph evidence. This is a research-oriented architecture role : you will not only design systems but also establish how their quality is measured, proven, and reproduced. Key responsibilities Knowledge graph quality & measurement Research, design, and evaluate methods for building high-quality knowledge graphs and applying them in AI systems. Define and operationalize graph quality metrics: coverage, consistency, accuracy, provenance, and uncertainty . Develop methods to measure completeness of graphs and detect information gaps. Information extraction & benchmarking Benchmark NER, entity resolution, relation extraction , and LLM-based extraction approaches for turning unstructured data into reliable graphs. Evaluate methods for ontology development, domain modeling, and concept hierarchies . Build benchmarks, baselines, and ablation studies; translate findings into reproducible experiments, evaluation frameworks, and practical recommendations. Graph analytics & reasoning Apply graph theory, statistics, and probabilistic methods to analyze structure, connectivity, communities, and information gaps. Investigate traversal and retrieval strategies (hop limits, edge direction, weights, relevance scoring, pruning). Design multi-step reasoning, critique, and verification workflows grounded in graph evidence. Research link prediction and graph embeddings , keeping inferred knowledge explicitly separate from verified facts. Required qualifications Mathematical foundations Strong grounding in graph theory, linear algebra, probability, statistics, and optimization . Research depth Demonstrated research experience in knowledge graphs, information extraction, ontology learning, semantic modeling, and graph-based machine learning (publications, dissertations, or equivalent applied research a plus). AI-native experimentation Practical ability to use LLMs and agent workflows to accelerate research, with a rigorous habit of validating results through evidence and measurement. Data analysis & programming Advanced Python ; SQL ; graph query languages (e.g., SPARQL, Cypher); reproducible research tooling. Evaluation judgment Rigorous experimental design: error analysis, uncertainty estimation, sensitivity analysis, ablation studies , and reproducible benchmarking. Nice to have Experience with enterprise knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL/SHACL/SKOS, and graph databases (Neo4j, ArangoDB, Virtuoso, GraphDB). Experience evaluating or building GraphRAG / neuro-symbolic systems that ground LLM output in structured knowledge. Familiarity with regulated or enterprise environments and provenance/audit requirements. PhD or research-track background in semantic web, NLP, or graph ML.

projects.description: Project Goal: Design and engineer a custom large-diameter winding core, a roll support system on a metal pallet, and a structural reinforcement of an existing oven for heat treatment of plastic film rolls at approximately 150 °C. The project is located in Herbolzheim (Baden-Württemberg, near Freiburg im Breisgau). Background: Nano-coatings are applied to plastic films with a thickness of 25–50 µm and a web width of 1600–1800 mm. Currently, the film is wound on a 6-inch metal core and placed in an oven for long-duration heat treatment at approx. 150 °C. Rolls can weigh several hundred kilograms. Three core problems must be solved: the existing 6-inch core diameter damages the film and must be replaced by a custom core of Ø 400 mm or more; the roll must be loadable into the oven on a pallet using a forklift or stacker; and the oven structure must be reinforced to handle heavy loads it was not originally designed for. Main Tasks: 1) Large-Diameter Core Assembly - Design a core shell with Ø ? 400 mm for 1600–1800 mm web width - End flanges bored in the center to fit a 6-inch tube compatible with the existing winding/unwinding line - Flanges with openings (open/perforated design) to allow hot air to flow through the core during heat treatment - Requirements to be met: torque transmission for winding/unwinding, roundness and concentricity, low run-out and deflection under load, smooth surface without edges or weld marks that could damage the film, long-term suitability at 150 °C including consideration of thermal expansion, no particle or contamination risk, weight compatible with the existing line 2) Roll Support and Pallet - Design supports holding the core assembly at both ends (e.g. via the 6-inch tube ends), mounted on a metal pallet - The assembly must fit through the oven door and into the oven interior (approx. 119 × 203 × 219 cm, W × D × H); the roll axis runs along the 203 cm depth, making overall length (core + tube ends + supports) very tight at 1800 mm web width - Loading concept to be proposed for forklift/stacker with pallet inserted lengthwise (e.g. long forks, rails or loading trolley) - Material proposal with cost comparison among galvanized steel, aluminium and stainless steel (cost is a concern) - Total load (core + film + support + pallet): 500–800 kg - Concept for safely transferring the roll from the winding line to the support 3) Oven Reinforcement - Assessment of the existing oven structure - Design of a reinforcement suitable for 500–800 kg including safe loading (e.g. guides/rails), without compromising insulation and hot-air circulation 4) Future Option – To Be Anticipated in the Design - Very slow rotation of the core and film roll around its axis inside the oven (approx. 1 revolution per 4 hours) - Bearings suitable for 150 °C, drive interface, motor possibly positioned outside the oven Expected Deliverables: - Site visit and requirements review - Concept proposal(s) with rough fabrication cost estimate - 3D CAD model and structural calculations (loads, deflection, FEA where needed) - 2D manufacturing drawings, bill of materials and complete manufacturing file (materials, tolerances, welding, surface finish/treatment) - Support in selecting and briefing fabrication shops and comparison of quotes - Ideally: follow-up of fabrication including quality checks and acceptance, and support during on-site installation Requirements: - Mechanical design engineer or technician with experience in special machine construction, ideally in web handling or converting (winding cores, shafts, roll handling) - Experience with steel and aluminium structures, design for high temperatures and material selection - Proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks, Inventor, Creo) and static calculation/FEA - Languages: English or German; French is a plus Working Model: Design work can be done partly remotely. On-site presence is required for kick-off and measurements, fabrication follow-up and installation. Project location is Herbolzheim, Baden-Württemberg, near Freiburg im Breisgau.

As the Validation Lead for CoreAI Lab Instrument Integration, you will direct the Computer Systems Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) strategy for integrating analytical and quality control laboratory instruments into the Tetra Data Platform (TDP). You will bridge the gap between fast-paced experimentation in Analytical Development (AD-non GxP) and strict GxP compliance in Quality Control (QC). Working directly with instrument specialists, data engineers, automation architects, and QA SMEs, you will ensure our automated data acquisition pipelines safeguard data integrity, satisfy 21 CFR Part 11 standards, and accelerate release-by-exception for life-saving cell therapies. Responsibilities: ? Validation Strategy & Governance: Formulate and execute a validation strategy for laboratory instrument integration via the Tetra Data Platform, ensuring alignment with GAMP 5, Roche Quality Management Standards, and global health authority regulations (FDA, EMA, Swissmedic). ? Pipeline & Interface Qualification: Author and execute validation master plans (VMP), user requirements specifications (URS), risk assessments, and qualification protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) for Tetra Data Hubs, Tetra Agents, cloud connectors, and raw-to-IDS (Intermediate Data Schema) parsing pipelines. ? Data Integrity & Compliance Architecture: Enforce ALCOA+ data integrity principles and 21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11 compliance across all instrument data streams. Qualify automated audit trail capture, electronic signatures, and bidirectional metadata flows between instruments and Level 3 systems (LIMS, ELN, LES). ? Risk-Based Testing & Test Automation: Lead end-to-end verification and boundary testing alongside dedicated testers and QA. Drive the adoption of automated test scripts within CI/CD pipelines to validate data ingestion schemas and reduce manual regression testing. ? Stakeholder & Vendor Alignment: Collaborate closely with Analytical Development scientists, QC lab leads, IT/OT engineers, and cloud platform architects to define scope and acceptance criteria. Partner with vendors (TetraScience, analytical instrument Original Equipment Manufacturers) to review vendor documentation and establish supplier quality assessments. ? Lifecycle & Change Management: Manage the validation lifecycle through operational changes, patch releases, schema upgrades, and new instrument onboarding, maintaining a continuous state of control and inspection-readiness. Candidate requirements: ? Analytical Instrument & Platform Knowledge: Experience validating laboratory instrument interfaces (e.g., flow cytometers, automated cell counters, ddPCR, SPR/Biacore, HPLC/UPLC) and modern scientific cloud data platforms (specifically TetraScience/Tetra Data Platform). ? Regulatory & Framework Mastery: Knowledge of GAMP 5, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and PIC/S data integrity guidance. ? Validation Documentation: Strong track record authoring clear, audit-ready validation deliverables (Traceability Matrices, Risk Assessments, Test Protocols, Validation Summary Reports) in electronic quality tools (e.g., ServiceNow, HP ALM, or Jira). ? Direct experience in Cell and Gene Therapy (CGT) technical operations is a plus ? Familiarity with Roche's internal CSV frameworks and Quality Management System processes is a plus. ? Knowledge of pharma and/or cell & gene therapy supply chain processes is a plus. ? Demonstrates ability to perform detail-oriented work with a high degree of accuracy and is able to explain complex concepts with clarity and simplicity. ? Demonstrates ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues quickly and effectively. ? Positive attitude and high energy with exceptional cross-group collaboration working with partner teams ? Possess a combination of analytical thinking, hands-on problem-solving, and a customer-service mindset ? Experience in ServiceNow and AWS technologies ? Excellent communication skills—fluent in written and spoken English. ? Language—English / Travel Requirement—20% (as needed) If interested in this role, please share your CV to ***@***.com

projects.description: We are looking for Network Engineers to support customer-facing network services delivered through public cloud infrastructure. We are interested in engineers who have a strong foundation in networking, complemented by practical experience working with public cloud environments. Candidates do not need to be experts across every cloud platform or technology. We value strong core networking skills, sound troubleshooting capabilities and a willingness to learn. Successful candidates will be supported in developing expertise in our specific cloud services, technologies and operational processes. Core Requirements Candidates should have practical experience in both traditional networking and public cloud infrastructure. 1. Networking A good working knowledge of several of the following areas: TCP/IP and IP networking fundamentals. Routing and switching. VPN technologies, configuration and troubleshooting. Firewalls and network security. Load balancing technologies. DNS and name resolution. Network troubleshooting, diagnostics and fault isolation. Candidates should be confident investigating complex connectivity issues, analysing network traffic flows and identifying the root cause of network problems. 2. Cloud Infrastructure Practical exposure to at least one major public cloud platform, such as: Amazon Web Services (AWS). Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience with cloud networking concepts and services, including virtual networks, subnets, routing, network security and connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments, would be beneficial. Experience across multiple cloud platforms is not essential. Additional Desirable Experience Hybrid cloud and on-premises connectivity. Cloud network architecture and design. Network monitoring and performance analysis. Infrastructure automation and configuration management. Working with customer-facing or business-critical network services. What We Are Looking For Above all, we want engineers with strong networking fundamentals, a methodical approach to troubleshooting and the ability to understand how network services operate within cloud environments. We recognise that cloud technologies and platforms can be learned. A strong networking background, practical engineering experience and the right attitude to learning are more important than having experience with every technology in our environment.

projects.description: The core of this role – please read before applying Our client does not need someone who can design a Service Desk on paper. They need someone who has run one – who has sat in the queue, owned the backlog, argued with L2 and L3 about handovers, and knows from experience why tickets get stuck, why users stop calling, and what a desk needs on a Monday morning to work. You will take over the live operation on day one and fix the acute problems first. Only then do you standardise what works across regions and put it into ServiceNow. After the build phase you stay and own the desk's performance – this is not a project that ends at go-live. Field experience in end-user IT support is the knockout criterion. ITIL and ServiceNow knowledge without it will not be sufficient. The client An international industrial group. IT support has grown regionally: each site runs its own queues, processes and interpretations of L1/L2/L3. The client wants one globally consistent Service Desk with standardised processes, clear global/local responsibilities and seamless cross-country support – and one person who builds it and then runs it long-term. What you will do Take over the running operation from day one: ticket flows, backlog, escalations and recurring incidents – together with L1/L2/L3 and the providers, with visible results within weeks, not quarters. Analyse the regional support set-ups on the ground: duplicated work, process gaps, justified local requirements versus historically grown exceptions. Build the global operating model: uniform prioritisation, routing, escalation and handovers; clear global versus local responsibilities for L1, L2 and L3. Translate it into ServiceNow with the ITSM team, roll it out with the regional IT organisations, stabilise after go-live. Own the Global Service Desk permanently: KPIs and service reviews, backlog and ageing, knowledge management, first-contact resolution, self-service and – once the foundations are stable – automation and AI. What you bring Several years of personal, hands-on responsibility of an end-user IT service desk – team, queue, SLA – ideally in an industrial or manufacturing environment. A career that came up through support – you have worked tickets yourself and know the operational nuances: routing, reassignment loops, IMAC, onboarding, local hands, what breaks when a site's label printer stops. Experience building or merging support structures across several sites or countries. ITIL in daily practice: Incident, Request, Knowledge, Service Level Management – applied, not certified only. KPIs you have defined and improved yourself: FCR, resolution times, backlog, user satisfaction – with before/after figures you can name. Full-time availability and commitment for a long-term engagement including the operational phase; German and English at working level. Nice to have: ServiceNow ITSM. Not the right fit ITSM process consultants, programme and transition managers, ServiceNow implementation leads, IT governance or VP-level profiles without own day-to-day desk responsibility. We say this upfront to save your time and ours. Interested? Send your CV to Georgii Dzhgarkava, eAces GmbH – ***** – or call *****. We reply within two working days and will ask you to complete a short self-assessment before we present you to the client.
